BEGIN;

CREATE TABLE teacher_onboarding_path_outcome_inbox (
    event_id UUID PRIMARY KEY,
    execution_id UUID NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    handoff_id UUID NOT NULL,
    student_id TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (student_id ~ '^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-4[0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$'),
    dialog_id UUID NOT NULL,
    teacher_job_id UUID NOT NULL,
    status VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('PATH_READY', 'ACTIVE_PATH_EXISTS', 'STATE_CHANGED')),
    course_id UUID,
    learning_path_id UUID,
    first_lesson_id UUID,
    personal_teacher_id UUID NOT NULL,
    body TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (btrim(body) <> '' AND char_length(body) <= 2000),
    occurred_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    accepted_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    dialog_message_id UUID,
    delivered_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
    FOREIGN KEY (handoff_id) REFERENCES teacher_onboarding_plan_handoff(planner_handoff_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
    FOREIGN KEY (personal_teacher_id, student_id) REFERENCES personal_teacher(id, student_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
    CHECK ((status = 'PATH_READY') = (course_id IS NOT NULL AND learning_path_id IS NOT NULL AND first_lesson_id IS NOT NULL)),
    CHECK (status = 'PATH_READY' OR (course_id IS NULL AND learning_path_id IS NULL AND first_lesson_id IS NULL)),
    CHECK ((dialog_message_id IS NULL) = (delivered_at IS NULL)),
    CHECK (delivered_at IS NULL OR delivered_at >= accepted_at)
);

CREATE INDEX teacher_onboarding_path_outcome_handoff_idx
    ON teacher_onboarding_path_outcome_inbox (handoff_id, occurred_at DESC);

-- Planner's terminal fact is immutable evidence. The sole lifecycle write is
-- the first verified Dialog acknowledgement; retries may observe it but cannot
-- substitute the message or delivery time afterwards.
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION protect_teacher_onboarding_path_outcome_identity()
RETURNS TRIGGER AS $$
BEGIN
    IF ROW(
        OLD.event_id, OLD.execution_id, OLD.handoff_id, OLD.student_id,
        OLD.dialog_id, OLD.teacher_job_id, OLD.status, OLD.course_id,
        OLD.learning_path_id, OLD.first_lesson_id, OLD.personal_teacher_id,
        OLD.body, OLD.occurred_at, OLD.accepted_at
    ) IS DISTINCT FROM ROW(
        NEW.event_id, NEW.execution_id, NEW.handoff_id, NEW.student_id,
        NEW.dialog_id, NEW.teacher_job_id, NEW.status, NEW.course_id,
        NEW.learning_path_id, NEW.first_lesson_id, NEW.personal_teacher_id,
        NEW.body, NEW.occurred_at, NEW.accepted_at
    ) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'teacher onboarding path outcome identity is immutable';
    END IF;

    IF OLD.dialog_message_id IS NULL AND OLD.delivered_at IS NULL THEN
        IF NEW.dialog_message_id IS NULL AND NEW.delivered_at IS NULL THEN
            RETURN NEW;
        END IF;
        IF NEW.dialog_message_id IS NULL OR NEW.delivered_at IS NULL THEN
            RAISE EXCEPTION 'teacher onboarding path outcome delivery acknowledgement must be complete';
        END IF;
        RETURN NEW;
    END IF;

    IF ROW(OLD.dialog_message_id, OLD.delivered_at)
        IS DISTINCT FROM ROW(NEW.dialog_message_id, NEW.delivered_at) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'teacher onboarding path outcome delivery acknowledgement is immutable';
    END IF;
    RETURN NEW;
END;
$$ LANGUAGE plpgsql;

CREATE TRIGGER trg_protect_teacher_onboarding_path_outcome_identity
BEFORE UPDATE ON teacher_onboarding_path_outcome_inbox
FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION protect_teacher_onboarding_path_outcome_identity();

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION protect_teacher_onboarding_path_outcome_delete()
RETURNS TRIGGER AS $$
BEGIN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'teacher onboarding path outcome evidence cannot be deleted';
END;
$$ LANGUAGE plpgsql;

CREATE TRIGGER trg_protect_teacher_onboarding_path_outcome_delete
BEFORE DELETE ON teacher_onboarding_path_outcome_inbox
FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION protect_teacher_onboarding_path_outcome_delete();

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION protect_teacher_onboarding_path_outcome_truncate()
RETURNS TRIGGER AS $$
BEGIN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'teacher onboarding path outcome evidence cannot be truncated';
END;
$$ LANGUAGE plpgsql;

CREATE TRIGGER trg_protect_teacher_onboarding_path_outcome_truncate
BEFORE TRUNCATE ON teacher_onboarding_path_outcome_inbox
FOR EACH STATEMENT EXECUTE FUNCTION protect_teacher_onboarding_path_outcome_truncate();

COMMIT;
